summary: There were 197 five-minute intervals below 0.0 $/MWh in the window; analysis threshold 0.0 $/MWh.

possible_explanations.statement: The event might reflect net oversupply (high generation relative to demand) in the intervals around the extreme; see generation change observations and dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the minimum (ev0938, ev0443).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve full five-minute generation-by-unit and interconnector flows for 2026-07-28T11:15:00Z to 2026-07-28T11:35:00Z and compare total generation plus net interchange to dispatch TOTALDEMAND for those intervals (the interval containing the extreme is 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z).

possible_explanations.statement: Constraint automation that limited exports or produced a binding co-optimised constraint might have contributed; see the constraint automation notice [c1].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect constraint binding reports and the invoked constraint set CA_SYDS_597A8B26 (notice [c1]) around 2026-07-28 11:00 AEST (which the notice shows as 2026-07-28T01:00:00Z UTC) and for dispatch intervals 2026-07-28T11:15:00Z to 2026-07-28T11:35:00Z to see if export-limiting equations were binding.

possible_explanations.statement: Non-conforming unit declarations or rapid unit trips/changes might have affected local dispatch outcomes; see the TRGBESS1 non-conformance notice [c3] and unit SCADA changes (ev0938).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review unit availability, trip logs and rebid activity for TRGBESS1 and units with large SCADA changes (e.g. GPWFWEST) for the window 2026-07-27T23:00:00Z to 2026-07-28T23:30:00Z to check for trips or availability changes coincident with negative price intervals.
